transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi there! Yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Just avoid heavy lifting or strenuous work for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for letting me know. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Some sensitivity to light can be normal while the eyes adjust to the new lens. If it is mild and things just seem brighter, wear sunglasses outside.

But severe light sensitivity, especially with a red and painful eye, is not normal and may need checking.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for the information. I have one more question: should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Yes, it can be normal for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after surgery. It should improve quickly and settle down over time.

If it is still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that covers everything I wanted to know. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thanks again for your assistance!

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` by stating "Some sensitivity to light can be normal while the eyes adjust to the new lens." in turn 7. `mild_case_advice` was also conveyed in turn 7 with "If it is mild and things just seem brighter, wear sunglasses outside." Finally, `escalation_criteria` was covered in turn 7 by "But severe light sensitivity, especially with a red and painful eye, is not normal and may need checking." All points were substantively conveyed.
